name: day-by-day-itinerary
title: Day by day
description: A tab per day with a zoomed map of where you are and a short list of things to do (3D emoji). Use for any multi-day trip or plan with places.

name: option-comparison
title: Compare options
description: Swipeable cards side by side with price, rating, pros and cons, and the best pick highlighted. Use when choosing between products, places, hotels, plans or services.

name: checklist
title: Checklist
description: Groups of tickable items with progress, and the ticks are remembered. Use for packing lists, prep, moving, errands or any to-do set.

name: timeline
title: Timeline
description: Dated steps down the page with what's done, now and next. Use for schedules, plans over weeks, recovery or training plans, histories and deadlines.

name: budget-breakdown
title: Budget
description: Bars per category with amounts, a total against the budget, and anything over budget in red. Use for trip costs, monthly spending, subscriptions or any money split.

name: recipe
title: Recipe
description: Ingredients that rescale with servings and steps you tick off while cooking (both remembered). Use for any recipe or meal plan.

example.title: Shakshuka
steps: Add tomatoes and spices, simmer 10 min
Crack in the eggs, cover until set

name: countdown
title: Countdown
description: Big number of days (or hours) to go with an emoji. Use for trips, birthdays, deadlines and events; good as a small Home widget too.
